_about: Feat loop, batch 5, lane b5-maneuver (2026-11-26): the manoeuvre and defence feats batch 4 did
not start. Each benefit is the book's (content/feats/feats.json, checked against aonprd.com
FeatDisplay 2026-11-26). The engine reads the tags in rules/maneuver_feats.py (feat loop b5
section) and rules/awareness.py; what still does not run is each document's `not_yet`.

not_yet: 'a creature ... that has no discernible head and neck is immune': the bestiary says nothing of a body's shape, so only the creatures immune to critical hits (and the types Stunning Fist cannot affect) are spared
'Escaping the whip by making a Strength check means the whip gains the broken condition': the whip lies on the ground unbroken
'or by using a full-round action to disentangle himself': the escape op offers the two checks and no sure way out
'If the whip has a magical quality such as flaming, apply this quality's damage to the target every round on your turn': a dropped weapon's properties do nothing
the held mouth's 'breath weapon': a creature's printed breath weapon does not run in the engine, and a class ability's breath (a draconic bloodline's) is not refused while the jaws are held
the `save` op's Reflex-half dangers (a trap's or a hazard's save): only a cast spell's and a class ability's area reach the wrestled foe — a creature's printed breath weapon does not run at all
